summary: The `no_valid_comparison` closure stands. The authors fitted three-age trends within four circadian windows. None of the inspected sources reports the registered 27-month versus 6-month effect across all 12 collection times. All 57 retained files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes. I corrected the description of Table S3: its activity-offset P and q columns are identical in all 604 shared rows, one identifier is stored as an Excel date, and the separate active-window sheet lacks statistics for Sept7. [Wolff et al.](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9929559/) · [Table S3](https://pmc-oa-opendata.s3.amazonaws.com/PMC9929559.1/NIHMS1870531-supplement-6.xlsx)
openIssues: The shared sheet leaves the activity-offset adjusted P values and the gene identity at A64 unresolved.
The original bioRxiv supplement files remained inaccessible. The preprint legend identifies the same window-specific analysis, and all ten PMC manuscript attachments were inspected.
